dynamic_state_requirement.scope: Complete semantic scope of the requested objective; exact numerical target extractor and native implementation remain unqualified.
dynamic_state_requirement.state: S_s(v) is UP, DOWN or FLAT for timeframe s and declared validity time/interval v, defined by the local observed price evolution at that scale rather than an arbitrary old issue-price line.
dynamic_state_requirement.forecast: At issue time t, forecast P(S_s(v)=c | information available at t), for future v and c in UP/DOWN/FLAT. The three probabilities sum to1 per s/v; a longer path may visit every state.
dynamic_state_requirement.continuation_and_change: Include sustained UP, DOWN and FLAT, entry into or departure from flatness, and reversals in both directions. No required return, fixed number of legs or fixed state duration.
dynamic_state_requirement.refresh: A later forecast may use newly available evidence. Preserve the earlier forecast and its information cutoff; do not credit retrospective recognition as advance prediction.
dynamic_state_requirement.scale: All M5/M15/H1/H4/D1 require explicit targets, consumption/loss mappings and evaluation. Different states across timeframes can be valid simultaneously; no mandatory agreement.
dynamic_state_requirement.meaningful_flatness: Flatness is a declared observed scale-specific state, not uncertainty, missing data, a zero mean, or cancellation of meaningful opposing moves. Every relevant move must remain visible in the assessment.
dynamic_state_requirement.path_and_timing: Preserve state order and movement size/duration in targets and assessment. Joint-transition probability claims require supporting output semantics; marginal state probabilities alone do not establish a joint path distribution.
dynamic_state_requirement.causality: Target observations may mature after v. Their prices, masks and retrospective turns cannot enter inputs at t or choose forecast issue times retrospectively.
dynamic_state_requirement.source_resolution: Declare price-source units, availability, sampled resolution and gaps. Unknown within-bar order remains unknown; coarse flat endpoints do not prove a quiet intrabar path.
dynamic_state_requirement.open_numeric_definition: Select and bind a reproducible local-state/transition definition, supported time/size domain, label maturity, uncertainty handling and matching loss before implementation. No guessed thresholds, automatic smoothing rule or model choice is adopted.
